captions.text: Job Explorer uses it to read each job posting, and score how well it fits you.
Local AI runs right on your computer, with a free program called Ollama.
It's the most private option, and it costs nothing to use.
Cloud AI uses Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini, with your own API key.
It's fast and capable, and the provider bills you for what you use.
Job Explorer checks your computer first.
Here it found a graphics card with eight gigabytes of memory, and recommends a model that suits it.
If you don't have Ollama yet, install it from the Ollama website, then start it.
On this computer, it's already installed and running.
Then pick a model to download.
The recommended one is marked for you.
Bigger models give better results, but need a bigger graphics card.
Click use, and Job Explorer runs a quick test to make sure the model works on your computer.
